items.topic: Last-updated-by stamp: running user vs default user
items.statement: Kobi first did not like that the 'last updated by' stamp could show the default workflow user for manual or ban changes and floated moving the stamping into the ban flows. After clarification, both agreed the default workflow user applies only to scheduled flows; screen flows and manual updates stamp the running user. This is acceptable because the scheduled flow only moves players from active to inactive.

That's okay then cuz Yeah. So if I click on ban without like the running user for that for your flow to stamp the player status would be me not necessarily the default workflow user. / Cedrick Infantado: Yeah. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Default workflow user is only for the schedule flow.
